baselines: see tasks_v2.json; all fit on the training block only

controls_and_ablations.note: v1 omitted the volatility group from its ablation list; v2 includes it

failure_conditions: calibrator, normaliser, regime threshold or feature selection fit on any outer-validation row (LeakageError)
frozen spec hash / protocol hash mismatch or modified v1 artifacts (seal check fails)
label causality or segment-protection test fails
a fold with fewer than 5,000 validation rows after dropping ties/ambiguous rows
unconverged fits beyond 10% of experiments (reported; results from unconverged fits flagged)
more than 24 configurations per label set attempted
folds: frozen F1..F5, purge/embargo/segments/eligibility exactly as frozen; chronological only; no random splits

directional_skill_gate_task_A.D1_discrimination: pooled balanced accuracy >= 0.505 AND lower 95% CI bound of (balanced accuracy - 0.5) > 0, under both block lengths and the day-cluster bootstrap
directional_skill_gate_task_A.D2_probabilistic: after calibration: log-loss skill vs training base rate > 0 with lower CI bound > 0 and point improvement >= 0.0003 nats
directional_skill_gate_task_A.D3_folds: balanced accuracy > 0.5 in >= 4 of 5 folds (n_eff-adequate folds)
directional_skill_gate_task_A.D4_robust_to_fingerprints: the same candidate family in NEUTRAL AND TRAILING_NORM retains >= 50% of the RAW lift with lower CI bound > 0
directional_skill_gate_task_A.D5_months: skill positive in >= 3 of the 4 validation months (Jun, Jul, Aug, Sep) and no month with the CI upper bound below 0
directional_skill_gate_task_A.D6_coverage: evaluated at 100% coverage; any abstention result is supplementary
directional_skill_gate_task_A.D7_placebo: the within-day label-permutation placebo (FP6) shows no skill (CI contains 0)

outcomes.WEAK/UNSTABLE: D1 point estimate positive in the pooled data and >= 4 of D1-D7 hold

opportunity_skill_gate_task_B.O1_discrimination: AUC >= 0.55 with lower CI bound > 0.5 (98.33% interval, both block lengths + day-cluster)
opportunity_skill_gate_task_B.O2_probabilistic: after calibration: log-loss skill vs training base rate with lower CI bound > 0 and point >= 0.005 nats
opportunity_skill_gate_task_B.O3_calibration: ECE <= 0.02 and slope in [0.9, 1.1] (diagnostic gates of calibration_v2.json)
opportunity_skill_gate_task_B.O4_beyond_volatility: AUC >= 0.52 in >= 2 of 3 train-defined volatility terciles (VT2) AND not VOLATILITY-DOMINATED (VT1)
opportunity_skill_gate_task_B.O6_fingerprints: survives NEUTRAL and TRAILING_NORM with >= 50% of the RAW lift
opportunity_skill_gate_task_B.interpretation: even when detected, this is event (volatility/opportunity) prediction, not directional skill

outcomes.WEAK/UNSTABLE: O1 holds and >= 4 of O1-O6 hold

multiplicity.note: stricter than v1 because the development data has been reused
multiplicity.task_B: 3 barrier variants -> Bonferroni-equivalent 98.33% two-sided CI for each

search_policy: this grid is final; never expanded after seeing results (a larger search needs protocol v3)

selection_rule.choice: highest S; if candidates are within 0.002 of the best S prefer: NEUTRAL or TRAILING_NORM over RAW, then logistic over LightGBM, then fewer trees/leaves
selection_rule.per: Task A: one choice. Task B: one choice per barrier variant (reported side by side)
selection_rule.screening_gate: mean AUC > 0.5 and AUC > 0.5 in >= 4 of 5 folds (n_eff-adequate folds only)

stage_metrics.confirmation: after nested-OOF calibration on the selected candidate: balanced accuracy, AUC, log-loss skill, Brier skill, ECE, slope
stage_metrics.screening: calibration-invariant: A = mean fold AUC; B = mean fold AUC (average precision reported); log-loss metrics are NOT used to screen

block_bootstrap.requirement: conclusions must hold under BOTH block lengths
block_bootstrap.resampling: within fold, paired with the baseline

day_cluster_bootstrap.requirement: reported; the gate uses the more conservative of the three intervals

effective_sample_size.series: per-row score contribution (log-loss difference vs the baseline)
effective_sample_size.underpowered_rule: a fold with n_eff < 500 is flagged UNDERPOWERED and cannot contribute a 'fold beats baseline' vote

verdict_scope: predictive classification only; no economic claim
